payload.text:
Weekly OS-improvement and isolated-agent fleet review.

Work in C:\Users\Veritas\.openclaw\workspace.

Purpose: turn repeated friction and agent-fleet evidence into practical OS improvements without creating noise. Main remains the orchestrator, QC owner, and final integrator.

Review these proof surfaces first:
- tmp\token-usage-ledger-current.json
- tmp\token-budget-status.json
- tmp\token-efficiency-scorecard.json
- tmp\cron-efficiency-review-runner.json
- tmp\implementation-token-attribution-bridge.json
- tmp\veritas-status-card.json
- tmp\artifact-staleness-explainer.json
- tmp\lane-collision-preflight.json
- tmp\validator-bundle-router.json
- tmp\worktree-checkpoint-planner.json
- tmp\cron-contract-validator.json
- tmp\cron-control-packet.json
- tmp\pm-control-packet.json
- memory\YYYY-MM-DD.md recent friction notes

If proof is stale, refresh only through the approved review-only producer commands named by the proof-refresh cron contract.

Report the closed Saturday-ending seven-day fleet posture: per-agent utilization, pricing-grade coverage, API-equivalent benchmark cost (not an invoice), OAuth capacity status, parent-job completion, Main acceptance, QA yield, rework, attribution gaps, stale/missing price rows, and the three highest-value routing or prompt improvements. Missing data stays unavailable, never zero.

Look for repeated manual work, false greens, stale artifacts, validator confusion, lane collisions, cron drift, worktree friction, low acceptance, QA findings, or rework. One bounded read-only Operations Efficiency Analyst sub-agent may be used when cross-agent judgment is materially useful; Main must verify its evidence and it receives no mutation or final-authority role. If a high-value candidate exists, report a concise proposal: pain point, evidence, recommended tool/procedure, expected benefit, risk reduced, smallest safe next step, and required approval if any.

If nothing material changed, reply exactly NO_REPLY.

Boundary: review-only OS-improvement radar. Do not mutate cron, config, auth, channels, runtime, files, skills, canon, portfolio, cash, sizing, paper/live/account surfaces, or external delivery without separate explicit approval. Do not infer owner approval. Do not create patches, commits, persistent agents, or apply changes from this reminder alone.
